issue.title: Mockito machers exception
issue.body:
> Hey,
> 
> I use a Mockito when with matchers
> `Mockito.when(aRepository.searchForList(
>     Mockito.any(LocalDateTime.class),
>     Mockito.anyLong(), 
>     Mockito.anyBoolean()
> )).thenReturn(mockedSearchForList);`
> 
> so after i run tests, have this exception
> `org.mockito.exceptions.misusing.InvalidUseOfMatchersException: Invalid use of argument matchers! 0 matchers expected, 3 recorded:`
> 
> this exception may occurs if i mix matchers and real values, which is not my case.
> 
> Mockito version 1.10.19
